$comment: #339. Where every gate check named by config/ceremony-profiles.json is implemented. Enforced both directions by test/check-registry.test.ts — a profile cannot name a check with no entry, and an entry cannot point at an implementation that is not there. Edit this when you add a check, not after someone asks where it lives.

acs-have-type.note: #339 made this true. The field was `.optional()`, so an AC with no type passed the check named after requiring one. 0 of 456 ACs across 82 recorded runs lacked a type, so refining it starts a check being enforced rather than starting it failing.

acs-have-threshold.note: A superRefine on ACSchema, not a test in workflow.test.ts. Three greps for `acs-have-threshold` found nothing; the rule is there under a different name, which is the whole reason this registry is data.

acs-no-behavioral-language.note: Same superRefine. #339 listed this among nine checks with no locatable implementation; it has one, spelled nothing like its profile name.

spec-drift.note: Part of the conformity suite the scaffold generates, not the workflow gate.

dead-exports.note: FALLOW-2. Warn-only unless the suite is run in failing mode, and skippable via opts.skipUnusedExports — so the profile naming it overstates what a THOROUGH run measures. Recorded rather than silently accepted; tightening it is a separate change with its own blast radius.

alwaysRun.$comment: Gate checks that run at every tier because nothing selects on the profile lists — see the spec. Listed so the reverse direction is enforceable: a check in a gate describe must be named by a profile OR appear here. Not an exemption list: each entry is asserted to exist, and the set is asserted to be exactly what is in the file.

delisted.$comment: #339 SC-4: named by a profile, resolving to nothing, removed from the profiles in the same change. Kept here so re-adding one without an implementation is a visible edit rather than a quiet one.
delisted.consumer-chain-verified: No implementation anywhere in lib/, gates/, scripts/, workflows/ or hooks/. Named by THOROUGH.verify. Nothing has ever measured it.
delisted.skill-qc-goal: scripts/skill-qc-validator.sh exists and nothing invokes it — no caller in any source directory, workflow or hook. Named by STANDARD.scope and THOROUGH.scope.
delisted.skill-qc-ship: Same uninvoked script. Named by STANDARD.verify and THOROUGH.verify.
delisted.evidence-target-valid: Removed in #315 because it asserted nothing, and replaced in #338 by evidence-portable after the measurement showed its premise did not hold.
